shots.title: Audit Node execSync callers that embed Unix stderr redirection (#514)
shots.notes: Audited production `src/cli`, `src/mcp`, and `src/core` call sites for Node-executed `2>/dev/null` usage, excluding generated POSIX shell templates.

shots.title: Replace Windows-unsafe Node command redirection with portable helpers (#514)
shots.notes: Added shared child-process stdio constants and moved git/npm stderr suppression into child-process options across guards, commands, MCP worktree cleanup, and lightweight repo detection.

shots.title: Add regression coverage for a formerly noisy guard or command path (#514)
shots.notes: Updated branch-before-commit guard expectations and added a production-source regression that fails if Node-executed code reintroduces POSIX `/dev/null` redirection.

conditions.description: Generated adapter and harness shell templates still contain POSIX redirection by design; the new regression excludes those files while scanning Node-executed production source.
`CODEBASE.md` is intentionally ignored in this repo, so `slope map` refreshed the local map but produced no tracked map commit.

training.description: Node commands that need quiet stderr should use child-process `stdio` options instead of shell redirection.
training.outcome: Windows no longer attempts to resolve `/dev/null` for the audited production command paths.

training.description: A source-level portability regression is useful when a bug spans many small command probes.
training.outcome: The test suite now fails fast if production Node-executed source reintroduces `2>/dev/null` outside generated shell templates.

nutrition.description: `corepack pnpm vitest run tests/cli/portable-exec-redirection.test.ts tests/cli/guards/branch-before-commit.test.ts tests/cli/guards/worktree-merge.test.ts tests/cli/guards/worktree-self-remove.test.ts tests/cli/guards/worktree-reuse.test.ts` passed: 33 tests.
`corepack pnpm typecheck` and `corepack pnpm prepare` passed.
`corepack pnpm test` passed on Windows: 230 test files passed, 1 skipped; 3628 tests passed, 25 skipped.
Branch-built `slope guard branch-before-commit` smoke produced empty stderr for a formerly noisy git branch probe.
`slope map --check` reported current after local map refresh.

nineteenth_hole.how_did_it_feel: A broad but well-contained cleanup. The audit had enough call sites to be risky, but each replacement kept the same try/catch behavior.
nineteenth_hole.advice_for_next_player: Generated shell snippets are a different category from Node-executed commands; keep that distinction explicit during portability audits.
nineteenth_hole.what_surprised_you: A tiny shared stdio constant was enough to make the change readable across commands, guards, MCP, and core detection.
nineteenth_hole.excited_about_next: With stderr portability cleaned up, S143.95 can focus on the atomic-write contention flake without this noise in the background.

bunker_locations: Mixing generated POSIX shell templates with Node-executed command strings can lead to over-broad mechanical rewrites.
Source-level grep regressions need explicit allowlists for generated shell templates.
yardage_book_updates: `src/core/process.ts` now centralizes quiet child-process stdio constants.
Production Node-executed `src/cli`, `src/mcp`, and non-template `src/core` sources no longer contain `2>/dev/null`.
`tests/cli/portable-exec-redirection.test.ts` prevents reintroducing POSIX `/dev/null` redirection in Node-executed production source.
course_management_notes: Issue #514 should close when the PR containing S143.9 merges.
`CODEBASE.md` is listed in `.gitignore`; the local map was refreshed but remains untracked.
S143.95 remains planned for #515 before the release sprint.
